name: The Maw of Ethiron
desc: The Maw of Ethiron is a large network of stone towers within the [Second Layer](location:the_ethironal_shrine), connected by small bridges that quickly crumble upon being touched. The [Cathedral of Ethiron](location:cathedral_of_ethiron) can be found at its center, a large building where [Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract) resides.
